text:
Maya: Got an EDR popup that quarantined something called "updaterd" and it wants me to reboot. I didn't install anything. Help?
Ava: @Maya please don't reboot yet. Can you share the device hostname and the alert id from the popup?
Maya: hostname: maya-m1.local, alert id: EDR-20250402-4412
EDR-Bot: Alert EDR-20250402-4412 - Action: quarantined /Users/maya/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.updaterd.plist; SHA256: 7f1c2a9d3b4e5f67890ab12c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4; Behavior: created LaunchAgent, executed /Users/maya/Library/Updater/updaterd, outbound TLS to 198.51.100.23:443 with SNI "updates.red-verify.net"; User: maya@redwood.com
Ravi: Copying @Ava 12 isolating device now. @Maya any external drives or VPNs?
Maya: No external drives. VPN was off. I had Chrome with a docs tab and Slack.
Ravi: Running isolation + data collection. Commands: ```
edrctl isolate --id maya-m1.local --reason "suspected-updater-agent"
edrctl collect --id maya-m1.local --out /tmp/triage-4412.tgz
md5sum /Users/maya/Library/Updater/updaterd 
```
Ava: Also pull KMS audit/logs for maya@redwood.com for last 48h and check IAM role changes. We need to rule out any key exposure.
Ravi: KMS/IAM quick check: no key usage, no console sign-ins from that user in last 48h. Uploading triage bundle to s3://redwood-triage/ENGSEC-3192/triage-4412.tgz and attaching to ticket ENGSEC-3192.
Jordan: If we need a reprovision I'll prep a loaner. @Maya do you want one preemptively? :hand: 
Maya: Laptop is fine, slow-ish but usable. I'll take a loaner if you recommend it.
Ravi: Local antivirus scan shows: ```
Quarantine: /Users/maya/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.updaterd.plist
Removed binary: /Users/maya/Library/Updater/updaterd
Network: 198.51.100.23 -> TLS SNI updates.red-verify.net
```
Ava: Looks like classic masquerade persistence. @Ravi add this SHA to global blocklist and push a YARA rule for LaunchAgents named updaterd and path patterns under Library/Updater. Also create an egress rule for TLS SNI matches to updates.red-verify.net.
Ravi: Done: Blocklist entry BL-761 created, YARA rule rolled out (agents v3.2.0), outbound TLS SNI detector deployed. Also pushed a script to scan home directories for LaunchAgents matching updater* and known hashes.
EDR-Bot: Device maya-m1.local isolated at 2025-04-02T11:12:30Z. Triage bundle uploaded.
Ava: Scope summary: no lateral movement seen, no KMS key ops, no RBAC changes. We'll set a 72-hour elevated watch on EDR telemetry and VPC egress from user endpoints and review firewall logs.
Maya: Thanks everyone 64f
Ravi: Follow-up full system scan completed, nothing else found. User rebooted after quarantine; behavior normal. Marking as contained for now.
Ava: Post-incident action items:
- Create ENGSEC-3192 incident with timeline & artifacts
- Blocklist + YARA + egress rule deployed
- 72h telemetry & KMS audit watch
- Update endpoint playbook to include the updaterd LaunchAgent pattern and SNI indicator
- Offer device replacement if any instability observed
Jordan: Noted. Happy to coordinate swap if Maya requests.
Maya: All good, appreciate the quick assist!
